),
channelized AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN source IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yandex')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN source IN ('google', 'bing', 'yahoo', 'baidu', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yandex') THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'^(.*facebook.*|.*fb.*|.*instagram.*|.*twitter.*|.*linkedin.*|.*pinterest.*|.*tiktok.*)$')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'^(.*youtube.*|.*vimeo.*|.*dailymotion.*|.*netflix.*|.*twitch.*)$')
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN (source IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'ebay', 'etsy', 'stripe', 'walmart', 'google shopping', 'shopify')
            OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(campaign, ''), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$'))
           AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*cp.*|ppc|retargeting|paid.*)$') THEN 'Paid Shopping'
      WHEN source IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'ebay', 'etsy', 'stripe', 'walmart', 'google shopping', 'shopify')
           OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(campaign, ''), r'^(.*(([^a-df-z]|^)shop|shopping).*)$') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'^(.*facebook.*|.*fb.*|.*instagram.*|.*twitter.*|.*linkedin.*|.*pinterest.*|.*tiktok.*)$') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'^(.*youtube.*|.*vimeo.*|.*dailymotion.*|.*netflix.*|.*twitch.*)$') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*video.*)$') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'^(.*email.*|e-mail.*|e_mail.*|e mail.*)$') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(source, r'^(.*email.*|e-mail.*|e_mail.*|e mail.*)$') THEN 'Email'
      WHEN medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'push$') OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(medium, r'mobile|notification') THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN REGEXP_CONTAINS(COALESCE(campaign, ''), r'cross-network') THEN 'Cross-network'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel,
    session_count
  FROM sessions
)

WITH page_views AS (

parsed AS (

    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(3)], NULL) AS seg_4,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], NULL) AS seg_5,
    IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 1, segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments)-1)], NULL) AS last_segment,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 1, segments[OFFSET(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments)-1)], '')), r'\+') AS last_has_plus,
    REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(CONCAT(IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(3)], ''), ' ', IF(ARRAY_LENGTH(segments) >= 5, segments[OFFSET(4)], ''))), 
      r'accessories|apparel|brands|campus collection|drinkware|electronics|google redesign|lifestyle|nest|new 2015 logo|notebooks journals|office|shop by brand|small goods|stationery|wearables') AS has_category
  FROM parsed

  WHERE plp.page_type = 'PLP'
)

user_activity AS (

    CAST(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS DATE) as uninstall_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180901' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'app_remove'

uninstall_within_7 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fo.user_pseudo_id
  FROM first_openers fo
  JOIN uninstallers u ON fo.user_pseudo_id = u.user_pseudo_id
  WHERE DATE_DIFF(u.uninstall_date, fo.first_open_date, DAY) BETWEEN 0 AND 7

crash_users AS (

       FROM uninstall_within_7 u
       JOIN crash_users c ON u.user_pseudo_id = c.user_pseudo_id),
      (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id) FROM uninstall_within_7)

home_sessions AS (

both_sessions AS (

SELECT

WITH page_views AS (
  SELECT 
    event_timestamp,
    (SELECT ep.value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'page_title') AS page_title,
    (SELECT ep.value.string_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) AS ep WHERE ep.key = 'page_location') AS page_location,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_timestamp) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_20210128`
  WHERE event_name = 'page_view'
    AND user_pseudo_id = '1362228.4966015575'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT 
    rn,
    page_title,
    page_location,
    CASE 
      WHEN page_location IS NULL THEN page_title
      ELSE
        CASE
          WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 6
               AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(SAFE_CAST(ARRAY_REVERSE(SPLIT(page_location, '/'))[OFFSET(0)] AS STRING), r'\+')
               AND (
                 REGEXP_CONTAINS(SAFE_CAST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)] AS STRING), r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus\s+Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google\s+Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New\s+2015\s+Logo|Notebooks\s+Journals|Office|Shop\s+by\s+Brand|Small\s+Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
                 OR
                 REGEXP_CONTAINS(SAFE_CAST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(4)] AS STRING), r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus\s+Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google\s+Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New\s+2015\s+Logo|Notebooks\s+Journals|Office|Shop\s+by\s+Brand|Small\s+Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
               )
          THEN 'PDP'
          WHEN ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) >= 6
               AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(SAFE_CAST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)] AS STRING), r'\+')
               AND NOT REGEXP_CONTAINS(SAFE_CAST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(4)] AS STRING), r'\+')
               AND (
                 REGEXP_CONTAINS(SAFE_CAST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(3)] AS STRING), r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus\s+Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google\s+Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New\s+2015\s+Logo|Notebooks\s+Journals|Office|Shop\s+by\s+Brand|Small\s+Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
                 OR
                 REGEXP_CONTAINS(SAFE_CAST(SPLIT(page_location, '/')[OFFSET(4)] AS STRING), r'(?i)(Accessories|Apparel|Brands|Campus\s+Collection|Drinkware|Electronics|Google\s+Redesign|Lifestyle|Nest|New\s+2015\s+Logo|Notebooks\s+Journals|Office|Shop\s+by\s+Brand|Small\s+Goods|Stationery|Wearables)')
               )
          THEN 'PLP'
          ELSE page_title
        END
    END AS display_title
  FROM page_views
),
deduped AS (
  SELECT 
    rn,
    display_title,
    CASE 
      WHEN LAG(display_title) OVER (ORDER BY rn) = display_title THEN 0 
      ELSE 1 
    END AS is_first_in_sequence
  FROM classified
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS num_steps,
  '1362228.4966015575' AS pseudo_id,
  STRING_AGG(display_title, '>>' ORDER BY rn) AS navigation_flow
FROM deduped
WHERE is_first_in_sequence = 1
